newsitem.title: USA: TV Azteca moves higher in debut.
newsitem.headline: TV Azteca moves higher in debut.

text.p: Mexico's TV Azteca SA got a warm welcome in its New York debut Friday, quickly jumping above its starting price after its initial public offering.
American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) in Mexico's No.2 broadcaster were up 7/8 to 19-1/8 in early afternoon trading, compared with an initial pricing of 18-1/4. The ADRs opened at 19-1/2.
Within half an hour of their 1236 EDT/1436 GMT start, TV Azteca ADRs were the third most-active shares on the New York Stock Exchange, with 4.6 million ADRs traded.
TV Azteca also started trading in Mexico City and elsewhere. The total issue was 28.8 million shares.
The U.S. portion was 17 million, with each ADR representing four underlying Mexican shares.
The company had cut the size of the issue from 40 million to 37 million shares over the weekend, and then reduced it again Thursday night to 28 million.
